response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the 6+ years experience requirement with nearly two decades of fullstack work, strong recent TypeScript/Node.js/React experience, hands-on AI agent and MCP tooling development, and demonstrated craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks he authored). The main gaps are no explicit Nest.js or Vitest experience and dated Kotlin/Java exposure, but his breadth and testing-first mindset suggest these are easily bridged.
strengths: Extensive fullstack TypeScript/Node.js/React experience with MongoDB, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes
Current hands-on AI agent development, including MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks
Strong engineering culture: TDD, pairing, CI/CD, trunk-based development, plus authored testing libraries and taught testing workshops
concerns: No explicit Nest.js experience mentioned anywhere in the resume
Java exposure is dated (2016–2018) and no Kotlin or Python listed
No direct mention of Vitest, Jest, or Playwright, despite general testing depth

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js and required secondary languages (Kotlin, Python)
